title: Cloud Controller 2.3.13
summary: Firewall registration through a single public address, per-customer controller spaces and a documentation site.

items.title: Single registration address
items.body: The join code and the registration answer can point to one public address, so every firewall registers at cloud.nexwall.com.br while each customer keeps its own controller host.

items.title: Controller space per customer
items.body: Each partner customer has its own controller space, opened from the Partner Portal with single sign-on.

items.title: Documentation site
items.body: The manual of the controller is published at controllerdocs.nexwall.com.br in English, Spanish and Portuguese, and the help button opens the page of the current screen.
